scientific_question: Does a detached semi-relaxed transport partition improve geometric or boundary representation beyond both hard weighted-FPS/voxel pooling and ordinary same-support row-softmax pooling?

arms.hard: same weighted-FPS/voxel anchors; one spatial-nearest proxy per source; P_ij=m_i*1[j=a(i)]
arms.row_softmax: same anchors, sparse support and geometry cost as SROT; exact hard source marginal; tau=0
arms.srot: same anchors, sparse support and geometry cost; exact hard source marginal; tau=1 target-capacity KL

held_fixed: geometry cost for row_softmax and SROT
one fine and one proxy LMAO block
optimizer, schedule, epochs, crop protocol and checkpoint rule

representation_metrics.normalized_symmetric_chamfer: Using CPU cKDTree only at evaluation: mean_i min_j ||x_i-x'_j||^2 plus mean_j min_i ||x'_j-x_i||^2, divided by squared source bounding-box diagonal; lower is better.
representation_metrics.transport_normal_distortion: sum_(i,j) P_ij*(1-abs(n_i^T n'_j))/sum_(i,j)P_ij; lower is better.
representation_metrics.oracle_boundary_accuracy: A valid source is boundary iff at least one valid fine-kNN neighbor has a different class. Proxy class is argmax_c sum_i P_ij*1[y_i=c]. Decode by the frozen nearest-barycentric-proxy map and score only boundary sources; higher is better.
representation_metrics.tail_oracle_recall: Macro recall of the same evaluation-only oracle decoder over the 11 frozen S0 tail classes; higher is better.
representation_metrics.proxy_mass_cv: std(m'_j)/mean(m'_j), reported as a diagnostic only and forbidden as the sole S5 pass metric.
representation_metrics.labels_policy: Labels enter only after the detached plan and proxy geometry are complete; they cannot affect anchors, support, cost or transport.

representation_pass_rule.comparison: SROT must beat both hard and row_softmax in paired mean

go_no_go.enable_differentiable_transport: only if the detached SROT representation pass rule and learned noninferiority gates pass
go_no_go.failure_action: retain the strongest hard or row-softmax coarsener and do not implement differentiable Sinkhorn
